inlineTransforms: echo "retry-tool sh -c \"rm -rf mingw && git clone '$SCRIPT_REPO' mingw\" && cd mingw && git checkout \"$SCRIPT_COMMIT\""
echo "cd iconv && retry-tool sh -c \"rm -rf gnulib && git clone --filter=blob:none '$SCRIPT_MIRROR2' gnulib\" && git -C gnulib checkout \"$SCRIPT_COMMIT2\" && rm -rf gnulib/.git"
echo "retry-tool sh -c \"rm -rf iconv && git clone '$SCRIPT_MIRROR' iconv\" && git -C iconv checkout \"$SCRIPT_COMMIT\""
echo "retry-tool sh -c \"rm -rf lame && svn checkout '${SCRIPT_REPO}@${SCRIPT_REV}' lame\" && cd lame"
echo 'char * strndup(const char *s, size_t c);' >> config.h
echo 'Requires: libpulse-simple xxf86vm xscrnsaver xrandr xfixes xi xinerama xcursor' >> "$FFBUILD_DESTPREFIX"/lib/pkgconfig/sdl2.pc
